author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists to build comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio is hiring illustrators and comic production roles
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions filled.

author: oaktree_comics
title: Oak Tree Comics hiring artist for picture book
content: WE’RE HIRING ARTISTS! Oak Tree Comics is looking to hire an artist for a picture book. The envisioned drawing style blends modern comic book imagery with the warmth and kindness of a classic picture book. Thematically, the story explores urban wildlife coexistence through humor and lots of heart. Applicants should have a portfolio of picture book, comics, or sequential art. For full submission guidelines, please visit the link in bio.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking graphic designer / character visual design for Taipei exhibition
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Scope: main visual, logotype, 6 character visuals (not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banner, other exhibition derivatives, print prep. Timeline Oct-Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn / Japanese / warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
